purpose: Replace PAPA/MAMA as core father/mother vocabulary with dignified HNK-native primitives while preserving recovered evidence and HNK V3 anti-cognate governance.

PATRO.reason: Exact Esperanto patro = father; would make HNK father look directly borrowed from Esperanto.

MATRA.reason: Strong Sanskrit-adjacent association: mātṛ = mother, while mātrā/mātra has measure/quantity senses; high cognate/false-cognate ambiguity.

father.meaning_pt: pai; progenitor masculino humano em registro respeitoso/neutro
father.meaning_en: father; male human parent in respectful/neutral register
notes: No paternal morpheme is inferred from DAR-, -UNO or any substring.
Chosen for HNK euphony and lexical independence, not external etymology.

mother.meaning_pt: mãe; progenitora feminina humana em registro respeitoso/neutro
mother.meaning_en: mother; female human parent in respectful/neutral register
notes: Rare external proper-name/brand and unrelated lexical occurrences exist; no common cross-language mother meaning was found in the preliminary scan.
No maternal morpheme is inferred from NE-, -LARA or any substring.

pair_design.reference_inspiration: PATRO/MATRA cadence and dignity only; no borrowed root or meaning
pair_design.divine_title_boundary: These candidates denote human parents only. They do not automatically define a title for God the Father or any theological title.
